nodes.rationale: When SPECS and DESIGN disagree, SPECS is authoritative for the implemented state; DESIGN is the historical v1 contract.

nodes.label: No plugin API: allowlist + skills instead
nodes.community_name: External tools: rtk, graphify, skills ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: no plugin api: allowlist + skills instead
nodes.rationale: A tool is available when its command is shell.allow-listed and its usage guidance ships as a skill — two simple mechanisms replace a plugin API.

nodes.label: Shell analyser unwraps rtk to prevent allowlist laundering
nodes.community_name: External tools: rtk, graphify, skills ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: shell analyser unwraps rtk to prevent allowlist laundering
nodes.rationale: rtk <cmd> is checked as both rtk and <cmd>; shell-string forms and unknown options are refused because the analyser cannot see inside them.

nodes.label: Symlinked skill directories are skipped by design
nodes.community_name: External tools: rtk, graphify, skills ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: symlinked skill directories are skipped by design
nodes.rationale: Skill bodies load through the read jail, so installed skills must be copied, not symlinked.

nodes.label: Prefer rtk compressed output for command tokens
nodes.community_name: External tools: rtk, graphify, skills ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: prefer rtk compressed output for command tokens
nodes.rationale: Same signal with far fewer tokens; but do not wrap commands whose full output must be parsed exactly (e.g. a diff to be applied as a patch), and file reads must go through moca's tracked read/search/ls tools.

nodes.community_name: 2. openai — decision: `ship oauth` (Sign in with ChatGPT — open-source token sharing)
nodes.norm_label: strict jsonc config decode, no unknown keys
nodes.rationale: Unknown keys are rejected so typos fail fast; adding a config key requires defaults + validation + SPECS update.

nodes.label: Anthropic decision: api_key only
nodes.community_name: 2. openai — decision: `ship oauth` (Sign in with ChatGPT — open-source token sharing)
nodes.rationale: Anthropic's terms prohibit third-party developers offering Claude.ai login or routing requests through consumer-plan credentials; config validation rejects providers.anthropic.auth=oauth with the recorded reason.

nodes.label: Policy gate: unclear terms are treated as not permitted
nodes.community_name: 2. openai — decision: `ship oauth` (Sign in with ChatGPT — open-source token sharing)
nodes.norm_label: policy gate: unclear terms are treated as not permitted
nodes.rationale: Before any OAuth code for a provider, the vendor's terms are verified live; unclear is treated as not permitted; no workarounds or spoofed client identities.
